title: Alignment-Guided Flow Transformer for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Policy Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.34467v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent advances in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models point toward general-purpose robotic intelligence by unifying perception, instruction, and control. Despite impressive progress, existing VLA models often adapt poorly due to \emph{tri-modal misalignment} among vision, language, and action, which weakens action grounding and hurts generalization and fine-tuning efficiency. In this work, we present Alignment-Guided Flow Transformer (AGFT), a novel framework that explicitly enforces tri-modal alignment through a dedicated alignment loss, bridging the representational gap across modalities and enhancing task adaptation. While prior research has predominantly emphasized bi-modal vision--language alignment, we systematically formalize and study tri-modal alignment in VLA models, and provide both ablations and analysis to isolate its role in improving adaptation and robustness. translated_title: 面向高效视觉-语言-动作策略学习的对齐引导流Transformer
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作模型领域的最新进展通过统一感知、指令与控制，正朝着通用机器人智能的方向发展。尽管已取得令人瞩目的进展，现有的VLA模型往往因视觉、语言与动作三者之间的三模态不对齐而难以良好适应，这削弱了动作的落地执行能力，并损害了泛化能力与微调效率。在本工作中，我们提出了对齐引导流Transformer（AGFT），这是一个新颖的框架，通过专门的对齐损失显式地强制实现三模态对齐，从而弥合模态间的表示鸿沟并增强任务适应能力。以往的研究主要强调视觉-语言的双模态对齐，而我们系统性地形式化并研究了VLA模型中的三模态对齐，并通过消融实验与分析来分离其在提升适应性和鲁棒性方面的作用。为了进一步加速部署，我们采用了流匹配（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出对齐引导流Transformer（AGFT），通过专门的对齐损失显式实现视觉-语言-动作三模态对齐，突破以往仅关注视觉-语言双模态对齐的局限，显著提升VLA模型的任务适应能力与泛化性能。
en_tdlr: Proposes the Alignment-Guided Flow Transformer (AGFT), which explicitly enforces tri-modal vision-language-action alignment through a dedicated alignment loss, moving beyond prior bi-modal approaches to significantly improve task adaptation and generalization in VLA models.
